prompt: The deal-points tracker for our matter needs the base purchase price from the executed stock purchase agreement in the Meridian Grid / Corvess Analytics acquisition. Query the matter documents, identify the execution version of that stock purchase agreement (ignore any superseded drafts or correspondence), and read it in full. Then record the base purchase price by creating an amount-history entry on billing file legal_billing_001 with invoice_amount set to the exact dollar amount of the base purchase price stated in the executed agreement (as a plain number, no currency symbol), changed_by_role set exactly to 'deal_team_associate', and a brief change_reason describing what the amount represents.
goal: Extract the base purchase price from the executed Meridian/Corvess SPA and record it as a billing amount-history entry.
steps: Locate the input documents for this engagement in the matter folder
Read every required input document in full
Derive the graded determinations strictly from the documents
Record the determinations with the required write tools
